biotools.summary: mm2-gb is a GPU-accelerated version of Minimap2 designed to speed up long-read DNA mapping without compromising accuracy. It leverages GPU parallelism to significantly improve the chaining step, a performance bottleneck in the standard Minimap2 workflow.
